scope_note: Stage-2 Section 5 solver prerequisite: an exact second-eta differentiation primitive for one Eq. (5.7) Picard update, with the required previous-iterate third eta derivative exposed explicitly rather than approximated.

layers.landed_capability: Given analytic A0/A1 jets through d_eta^2, forcing through d_eta^2, and a previous Picard iterate through d_eta^3, returns the next Picard iterate through d_eta^2 by exact product-rule assembly followed by the canonical Eq. (5.7) singular inverse G.
layers.remaining_boundary: The current repaired hierarchy does not yet own the previous-iterate third eta derivative needed by the A1*d_eta W term. This primitive therefore remains generic solver infrastructure and does not by itself construct hierarchy-owned d_eta^2 W_n^(1), Picard convergence, finalized positive-order coefficients, the recursive cutoff-scale schedule, Proposition 5.3 residual decay, or paper-exact velocity.

forbidden_inferences: Caller-supplied analytic matrix, forcing, or iterate jets are not paper-exact coefficient data.
Centered finite differences in regression are test oracles only and are not production derivative paths.
Second eta differentiation of one Picard update does not establish Picard convergence.
The repository generic executable cutoff is not the paper recursively chosen cutoff-scale schedule.
Green CI does not promote formal-structure infrastructure to paper-exact velocity.
